citations.authors: Aschan, C.; Toivonen, M.; Seppälä, T.; Kotiluoto, P.; Auterinen, I.; Serén, T.; Stecher-Rasmussen, F.
citations.title: TL detectors in BNCT dosimetry
citations.venue: IAEA-TECDOC-1223, Current status of neutron capture therapy

provenance.derivation_note: Thermal neutron fluence (6Li response) depth profiles digitized from FIG. 3 of Aschan et al., TECDOC-1223 pp. 171: MTS-Ns TL detectors in cylindrical phantoms (20 cm diameter, 24 cm length) on the FiR 1 K63 epithermal beam central axis at the 14 cm aperture. MTS-Ns irradiations ran at 10 kW for 15 min; the published axis is a fluence RATE whose scale (peak ~2.3e9 n cm^-2 s^-1) is only physical at the nominal 250 kW power, so values are recorded at the 250 kW scale. Detector stations: water {1.0, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0} cm; PMMA adds a surface point at 0.2 cm; Liquid B matches water stations. Station values were digitized from the figure (symbol centers located by template matching; merged symbol clusters resolved from zoomed renders), then log-linear interpolated onto the declared bin centers — the interpolation convention is stated here rather than fabricating point values. Per-bin one-sigma uncertainties combine the paper's stated 13% (1 SD) total MTS-Ns uncertainty (TABLE I) with a 2.0e7 n cm^-2 s^-1 digitization allowance in quadrature. Spatial positioning uncertainty of the detectors in the water and Liquid B phantoms was stated as +/-0.5 cm. The phantom is the small Ø20x24 cm cylinder, NOT the ~51x51x47 cm cubical reference phantom used by the fir1-k63-water-phantom validation case — the comparison against that case's computed profile is therefore a peak-normalized shape comparison, recorded as such. The PMMA and Liquid B series are recorded for completeness under phantom-qualified metric names so they are not compared against the water-phantom computed profile.

measurements.note: Bin edges are depth in cm on the cylindrical water phantom central axis; bin contents are the digitized MTS-Ns thermal fluence rate at the bin center (log-linear interpolation between detector stations at 1.0, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0 cm).
PMMA phantom series (detector stations 0.2, 1.0, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0 cm). Phantom-qualified metric: recorded for completeness, not compared against the water-phantom computed profile.

Brain-substitute liquid (Liquid B) phantom series (stations 1.0, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0 cm). Phantom-qualified metric: recorded for completeness, not compared against the water-phantom computed profile.
